title: CV for a named role
when_to_use: A CV or resume sent for one role, read by a recruiter or a hiring manager.

personas.description: Recruiter screening many CVs for one role; spends under a minute on a first pass and decides who goes to the hiring manager.
Hiring manager for the role; reads the shortlisted CVs and decides who to interview.

dimensions.name: Fit to the role
dimensions.question: Does the first third of the page show the role's core requirements?

anchors.1: no requirement of the role appears on the first third of the page
anchors.3: some requirements appear, but the reader has to search for them
anchors.5: the role's main requirements are each matched by a line on the first third of the page

dimensions.name: Impact
dimensions.question: Does each line state a result rather than a duty?

anchors.1: lines list duties only, with no result
anchors.3: some lines state a result, most list duties
anchors.5: most lines start with a result and name the method after it

dimensions.name: Evidence
dimensions.question: Is each claimed result backed by a number, a scope or a named case?

anchors.1: no number, scope or named case
anchors.3: a few results carry a number or a scope, the rest are asserted
anchors.5: every claimed result carries a number, a scope or a named case consistent with the facts

dimensions.name: Clarity
dimensions.question: Can the reader find dates, titles and employers at a glance?

anchors.1: dates, titles or employers are missing or out of order
anchors.3: the facts are there but the layout hides some of them
anchors.5: dates, titles and employers are on one aligned line per role, in reverse order
